name: Ai-chan for Me ~Maid Choukyou Hen~
original_name: あいちゃん for Me～メイド調教編～
source:
Hero receives a letter from his friend inviting him to apply for a job in a mansion. There he meets three newly employed maids and chooses one of them to take care of his needs as man. The next day he is tasked by the mansion owner to train the same maid and he takes the job since he cares for the girl. Each girl has mental shackles and it depends on the main character whether the shackles are to be lifted or tightened.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公收到朋友来信，邀请他应聘一座大宅里的工作。他在那里见到三名刚受雇的女仆，并从中选出一人满足自己身为男人的需求。翌日，宅邸主人命令他调教同一名女仆；因为在意那个女孩，他接下了这份差事。每个女孩心中都有枷锁，而要让枷锁松开还是越收越紧，全看主人公的选择。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
